thread.body: Would you like to discuss selling your property?
Yes, let's talk about it.
Could we arrange a call to discuss the property?
Tomorrow at 2 works for me.
When would you like to talk about selling?
After 5 today.
Can we discuss an offer?
Give me a call Thursday morning.
Are you interested in an offer for the house?
Can you call me about it?
Can we call you tomorrow at 3 about selling?
Could we talk about selling tomorrow?
No, I am not selling.
Can we discuss selling your house?
Wrong person. I never owned that house.
Would you consider an offer?
The store opens at 9.
Call me at 3 about selling.
Actually stop texting me. Remove me from your list.
I might sell.
My attorney demands you cease all contact. I am on the Do Not Call registry.
Are you ready to talk about an offer?
Maybe someday. Not ready now.
